visualCharacteristics.layout: Single bar: label, horizontally scrolling anchor links, primary/secondary buttons; sticks to viewport top and highlights the section in view
visualCharacteristics.notes: "Jump To" label, row of in-page anchor links (Overview, Product Details, Documentation, Design Resources, Training, Support) and two buttons (Buy/Parametrics primary, Package/Quality secondary). Becomes sticky on scroll.

contentPattern.structure: 1 row x 3 cells: label | in-page anchor links | action buttons

reuseGuidance: Use for long pages with section anchors; anchors must match section ids.
